description: Table M held IDs 1-512 (200-character rows over many pages) and then lost IDs 1-100, 200-320 and 450-512, leaving empty first, consecutive middle and last page ranges. Open a table-type recordset on M with no Index (storage order), read RecordCount, read ID through a held Field at each row by MoveNext until EOF (at most 600), read BOF and EOF, then MoveLast and read ID by MovePrevious until BOF (at most 600), then BOF, EOF and RecordCount. Asks the visited row sequence and the boundary reports in both directions across empty pages. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
